description: List the project's ToDo cards. Without `status` only `open` cards are returned; closed cards (`done`, `dismissed`) only when asked for. `specificationId` keeps the cards whose origin or resulting specification is that one. Rows are full cards including `description` and `questions` (each card's open questions with their answers), ordered by priority, then newest. Returns an array ({items} in structuredContent).

specificationId.description: Only cards whose origin or resulting specification is this id (CLI: --specification).

status.description: Statuses to return (open | done | dismissed); omitted or empty means open (CLI: --status, repeatable).

name: todos_list
title: List ToDo cards
